sections.name: File setup, field, readLine, DocumentProcessor, OcrAdapter, SyntheticOcrAdapter
sections.title: Shared helpers and processing contract
sections.what: Sets up the helper that builds an extracted field, the helper that finds a labelled line in document text, and the rules that a document processor and a text reader must follow. The synthetic text reader returns the fixture text unchanged.
sections.why: Likely reason: separates the processing steps from any one implementation, so a real text reader could later replace the synthetic one.
sections.watch_out: Every extracted field gets a fixed confidence of 100, which would overstate certainty if real scanned text went through this path.

sections.name: SyntheticDocumentProcessor, documentFromFixture
sections.title: Turns synthetic document text into fields
sections.what: Searches document text for known labels such as Khata, Khesra, Area, Relationship and Map reference, and creates a field for each one found. The name field uses Recorded name, or Grandparent if that is missing. The document is then marked as extracted. A separate builder creates a new document from a fixture with no fields yet.
sections.why: Likely reason: the synthetic documents use fixed label wording, so simple label matching is enough to show the flow.
sections.watch_out: Labels are matched by exact text, so a document that spells a label differently will silently produce no field.

summary: Turns the text of synthetic documents into labelled fields such as khata number and area.
purpose: Shows how the app would pull known details out of a document, using fake documents that are safe to show.
why: Likely reason: simple, predictable label matching lets the demo work without real text recognition.
how: First, the synthetic text reader returns the fixture text unchanged. Then the processor looks for each known label in that text and creates a field for each one it finds. It marks the document as extracted. A separate builder makes a new, unprocessed document from a fixture.
inputs: A document with its source text, or a fixture with an ID, title, kind and source text.
outputs: A document with a list of extracted fields and state extracted, or a new document with no fields and state not-started.
risks: Every field has a fixed confidence of 100, which can overstate certainty. Missing labels produce no field and no warning. Label text is placed into a search pattern without escaping special characters.
debug: If a field is missing, open the source text and check the exact label spelling. If confidence looks wrong, remember it is always 100 in this path.
